requirements.id: cli.errors.Skill or command name refused
requirements.note: Spec: a refused frontmatter `name` leaves the skill loaded without that name, and names over 256 characters are refused. Code: outside a plugin a refused frontmatter name refuses the whole skill (strict), and no 256-character limit exists for skill/command names. errors.md "Skill or command name refused" agrees with the spec; the implementation should change. The notice text (skillNamesRefused) matches.

requirements.id: cli.errors.Path could not be checked
requirements.note: Only the message builders exist. The Files port reports absence as undefined and has no error-code channel, and no loader refuses a path whose check failed with a code other than not-found (or reports it per component vs. whole plugin). The implementation should add this; the spec text is right.

requirements.id: cli.errors.Plugin was not uninstalled
requirements.note: Effect conforms (stops, keeps data, exit 1, failureCode settings_still_on). Message differs: code prints `"<name>" was not uninstalled: <file> still switches it on, so it stays installed with everything it saved`; spec (and errors.md) quote `it is still switched on in <file>, although the settings change reported no error. It is still installed. Take it out of "enabledPlugins"…`, plus the `settings change failed (<error>)`, `is there and could not be read` and network-path variants, none of which exist. Implementation should change.

requirements.id: cli.errors.Claude Code refuses the marketplace name
requirements.note: `marketplace add` refuses the imitating name (`Marketplace name impersonates…`, marketplace-names.ts:110), and the builders marketplaceNameRefused / MARKETPLACE_NAME_LOOKS_OFFICIAL exist (host-errors.ts:65), but loadNameIssues leaves impersonation out, so a registered marketplace with an imitating name is not stopped on catalog read and its plugins keep loading; the settings-source steps are not produced. Implementation should change.
